notes: EP_genomewide.chinput: genome-wide promoter capture Hi-C on the CHiCAGO hg19 HindIII design, 22,076 baits, 119.8 M rows. Model of chicChicagoBackgroundModel on the chinput (derive_capture.sh step 10). Class EX, no Python counterpart: exit status and non-empty outputs are gated; the chinput-versus-matrix agreement and score sanity were measured outside the harness (report).

EP_genomewide_cpp.cool: the same chinput as a fragment-level cool (hicConvertFormat --inputFormat chinput, derive_capture.sh); bait-to-bait pixels hold the N of the pair once. Model of chicChicagoBackgroundModel --matrices on the same cool. Class EX, no Python counterpart: exit status and non-empty outputs are gated; the chinput-versus-matrix agreement and score sanity were measured outside the harness (report).
